newsitem.title: POLAND: Okocim expects sharp 1997 net fall.
newsitem.headline: Okocim expects sharp 1997 net fall.

text.p: Polish brewer Okocim SA expects its 1997 net profit to fall to between 16 and 18 million zlotys from last year's 27.2 million due to large investments in marketing and distribution, the company said in a statement.

Okocim said in its Friday statement that its marketing in 1997 would aim at increasing its market share by creating a new beer and stressed its smaller profit would not be a signal of deteriorating financial standing of the firm.

It said it planned to invest 89.5 million zlotys in 1997, rather than earlier expected 28.4 million in increasing its KEG's beer sales, expanding distribution network and improving quality of its beers and others.
